1. Vikram asal mein kis cheez ke liye message kar raha tha, aur uske pehle do messages ki kaunsi details yeh dikhati hain? Uske aakhri do replies ka kya matlab hai?
2. Aman se exactly kahan galti hui? Uske har move ko evaluate karo — alternatives, cousin ka example, "discipline" wali line, "dus darwaze" wali line.
3. Aman ko ab repair ke liye jo message bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa likho jaisa use bhejna chahiye.

1. Vikram UPSC/collector wale exam ke result ke baare mein message kar raha tha (failure announce karne ke liye). Uske pehle do messages clearly dikhate hain ki yeh uska last attempt tha, 10 saal lage the, papa ke retirement fund se Delhi coaching mein paise gaye, aur log ab usko mazak mein "collector sahab" bolte hain. Uske aakhri do replies ("haan. shayad." aur "haan theek hai. chal baad mein baat karte hain.") ka matlab hai ki woh baat band karna chahta hai, emotionally disconnect ho gaya hai aur Aman ki baaton mein interest nahi le raha.

2. Aman ki galti yahin hui ki pehle hi empathy dikhaye bina turant "solutions" dene lage. Alternatives (PCS/SSC) suggest karna jaldi tha jab Vikram sirf dukh share kar raha tha. Cousin ka CAT wala example bilkul irrelevant aur insensitive tha kyunki woh kisi aur ki success story thi. "Discipline aur GK" wali line ne Vikram ke 10 saal aur paise waste hone ko halka kar diya. "Ek darwaza band... plan banate hain" wali line forced aur cliche thi, jo uske dukh ko ignore karke aage badhne ki koshish karti hai.

3. "Bhai bahut bura laga sunke. 10 saal aur papa ke paise... samajh nahi aa raha hoga abhi kya karega. Bolna ho toh bol, main sun raha hoon."
